new_page.description: Industrial property for sale in Cloverdale: warehouses, shop condos and industrial strata on the MLS®, with vacancy, rents and industrial zones.

faq_heading: Cloverdale Industrial Property for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Commercial figures are from GVR Commercial Edge (Q2 2026) and Avison Young (Q3 2026); zones are the municipal bylaw summaries on the zoning guide. For sale listings only.

Industrial property for sale in Cloverdale: warehouses, industrial buildings, shop condos and industrial strata units listed on the MLS®. For sale only; space for lease is not included. Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361 to ask about one of these, or about something not listed.

In the second quarter of 2026, 19 of the 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey were industrial properties, against 81 across the Lower Mainland. Commercial Edge reports Surrey as one city, so the figure covers all of Surrey, not only Cloverdale.
Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® Commercial Edge, Q2 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).

Industrial space in the Surrey submarket (45.1M sq ft) was 4.2% vacant in the third quarter of 2026, asking $19.66 per sq ft net plus $6.95 in additional rent, with 1,628,917 sq ft under construction. Across Metro Vancouver vacancy was 4.0%.
Source: Avison Young, Metro Vancouver industrial market report, Q3 2026 (as reported on [the Fraser Valley commercial market report](/fraser-valley-commercial-market-report.html)).
City of Surrey zones that allow industrial uses

Each zone links to its full summary on the zoning guide. These are municipal zones, so some apply to parts of Surrey outside Cloverdale. A zone that allows a use may still need a permit or a rezoning for a specific site, so check the address with the municipality before you buy.

faq.q: Does this page include industrial property for lease?
faq.a: No, only property for sale. For lease listings, call or text Jared at 604-928-1361.

faq.q: How many industrial properties sold in Surrey recently?
faq.a: 19 in the second quarter of 2026, out of 53 commercial sales in the City of Surrey (GVR Commercial Edge).
